mutations.name: a reply is kept on fewer rows only
kills: the repair keeps partial progress a reply that clears some beats of the one failing row is kept for the next round

mutations.name: a new failing row is accepted with fewer beats
kills: the repair keeps partial progress a reply that adds a failing row is refused even with fewer beats

mutations.name: the seed ignores partial progress
kills: the repaired script over the seed is kept when it answers the same row on fewer beats

mutations.name: the seed accepts a row it never failed
kills: the repaired script over the seed is the seed when a split start brings in a row and the reply only trims it

mutations.name: each round asks from the kept script only
kills: each round asks from the best reply so far a reply that swaps the row for one on fewer beats is the next round's draft and rows, though not kept
